broadcast_message.description: Send a message to everyone following your official account. LINE returns no identifier for a broadcast, so this action has no output. Limited to 60 broadcasts per hour.
broadcast_message.display_str_template: Broadcast a LINE message to all followers.
broadcast_message.name: broadcast_message

parameters.description: The message to send. Up to 5000 characters.
parameters.name: text

get_bot_info.description: Fetch your own official account's name, basic ID, and picture. Useful for confirming which account a workflow is connected to.
get_bot_info.display_str_template: Get the connected LINE official account info.
get_bot_info.name: get_bot_info

basic_id.description: The account's basic ID, the '@'-prefixed handle people search for

picture_url.description: The account's profile image, or empty if none is set

user_id.description: The official account's own user ID

get_profile.description: Fetch the display name and picture of a user who has added your official account.
get_profile.name: get_profile

parameters.description: The LINE user ID, starting with 'U'. These arrive in the webhook events your official account receives.
parameters.name: line_user_id

language.description: The user's language as a BCP 47 tag such as 'en'. Empty until the user consents to LINE's privacy policy.

picture_url.description: The user's profile image, or empty if they haven't set one

status_message.description: The user's status message, or empty if they haven't set one

send_message.description: Send a message to one LINE user, group chat, or multi-person chat from your official account.
send_message.name: send_message

parameters.description: The LINE user ID, group ID, or room ID to send to. User IDs start with 'U' and arrive in the webhook events your official account receives -- this is not the public LINE ID people search for.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: The message to send. Up to 5000 characters.
parameters.name: text

message_ids.description: IDs LINE assigned to the message it sent. Useful for correlating with delivery reports.

description: Send LINE messages from your official account, and look up the profiles of the people who follow it.
